signal: Rank the original nine sector SPDR ETFs by trailing 126-session adjusted-close return, ending 21 sessions before the signal. Hold the top three only when their signal return is positive; each receives one third of the reference portfolio, with unused slots in zero-return cash.
rebalance: Signal at the last trading close of each calendar week. Rebalance at the next available trading close. Existing holdings earn returns before the new weights are applied. Start evaluation in cash; charge the first entry.
execution: Closing prices are bookkeeping reference marks with modeled costs, not verified executions. No intraday or auction fill simulation.
lag_inputs: Dollar ADV and daily return volatility are calculated from the previous 20 sessions and shifted one session. Trade-date volume and future volatility are never used as inputs.
impact_cost: For each asset order, average modeled cost per dollar traded = eta * lagged daily volatility * sqrt(order dollars / lagged dollar ADV). This is an assumed cost model, not an ETF-specific calibration or a universal impact law.
capacity_definition: Largest constant reference AUM for which every modeled asset/day order fits within 10% of its lagged dollar ADV. It is a planning-budget threshold, not a proven executable capacity.
annualization: 252 times mean daily gross or net modeled return. Dollar P&L equals reference AUM times this arithmetic annual rate. Reference AUM is held fixed for cost estimation; these are not CAGRs or a compounded net wealth simulation.
full_fills: The fixed exposure path assumes completed reference-price rebalances. Beyond the participation threshold, curves are explicitly infeasible extrapolations of that unchanged strategy. The study does not silently clip orders or change holdings.
selection: One fixed strategy and parameter set. No optimization across signals, universes, cost coefficients or holding periods. The nine funds predate the evaluation period; later sector funds are excluded.
limitations: Historical reference portfolio, current reconstructed adjusted prices, modeled spreads/fees/impact, daily volume proxies. ETF creation/redemption, underlying basket liquidity, execution duration, intraday conditions, taxes, funding and changing future alpha are excluded. Participation and cost assumptions do not establish a live allocation recommendation.
